consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 120 km/h steady, 15 °C, dry, 20-inch wheels (245/40-20 Continental PreCon 6), battery-side (car display; sheet does not say explicitly) | Nyland, 'Polestar 2 LR SM refresh' (2024+ refresh: rear single motor, 79.1 kWh measured, i.e. the 82 kWh refresh pack). Our variant shows 78/75 kWh from OpenEV, which looks stale for the 2024+ refresh; I attached the test to the real refresh car, so check our pack figure. Matches our 20-inch trim. 90 km/h, 16 °C: 153 Wh/km..
